Salad can be used to enhance the veggie taste.

ObjectName.value: Waffle with butter and maple syrup

Categories.value: Flickr images uploaded by Flickr upload bot|Sliced butter|Cylindrical waffles|Waffles with maple syrup

ImageDescription.value:
i made waffles the other day (part wheat flour and part almond flour). this one was frozen and i toasted it back up. i didn't realize how fast the syrup would soak in for the shot or how slow the butter would melt, so it looks kind of off from the original intent... i have some more in the freezer so i might try again!

for light, i used a canon 580ex connected via the canon flash cord at camera left. it had a gary fong lightsphere on it.
